title: HISTORICAL: LOSS_TOLERANT gap exceeding max_loss_tolerant_gap (obsolete)
description: SAR archive where a fragment gap exceeds max_loss_tolerant_gap even though LOSS_TOLERANT is set. Must fail closed when the gap exceeds the configured limit.
notes: HISTORICAL/OBSOLETE (WP-4): the canonical format carries no offsets, so a missing fragment's length and a gap size are unknowable. max_loss_tolerant_gap is retained as a public option but is not applied to fragment reassembly and is not given new semantics.
